verdict.rationale: No evidence documents a dedicated bulk-operations feature. Multi-item changes are only implied by programmatic routes: the official MCP server lets agents edit pages and restructure docs, Git Sync allows repo-level edits across many pages, the REST API supports PATCH/DELETE, and auto-translations update content across languages. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-edit/batch operation capability (UI or API batch endpoints), documentation of multi-item operations at scale, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
